title: Text Emotes
body:
Syntax: emotes  |  @<name>  |  ooc @<name>

Description: Browse 80 cosmetic text emotes. Use @yawn to show your current room that you yawn, or ooc @yawn to show everyone online [OOC] followed by your character's name and action.

Names are case-insensitive. Examples: @wave, @bow, @facepalm, @headband, ooc @laugh. No target or extra words are accepted.

Silence and shared chat spam limits apply. OOC emotes are recorded in chatlog; room emotes are not. These actions do not change stats, combat, or the world.

Date: 2026-09-19
